Corollary
1. Corollary 1.12\group harmonic-functions Source: han-lin-lecture-notes:page-0010 ↗ hanlin:lemma-interior-gradient-2

A harmonic function on $\mathbb R^n$ that is bounded above or bounded below is constant.
Proof

\sketch Add a constant and change sign if necessary so that $u\ge 0$. Apply Lemma 1 on arbitrarily large balls centered at a fixed point and let their radii tend to infinity; then $Du=0$ everywhere.

□
